# 1930s cartoon — Style Prompt

> Black-and-white hand-inked cartoon from the early sound era: a hero built from tubes, white gloves and pie eyes, a world that breathes on the beat, framed in a worn 4:3 film gate. Grammar only: never copy an existing character, name or silhouette. If the hero is an object, the whole object is the body.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

Hand-inked animation where **every object is alive**. Characters have **rubber-hose limbs** (constant-width tubes, no elbows, no knees), **white four-finger gloves**, **pie eyes** (white oval, black pupil with a wedge cut toward the upper right), huge round black shoes, and bodies that squash and stretch like balloons. Furniture, jars, clocks and walls **squash and stretch in time with one beat**. The picture looks like a worn 35 mm print in a 4:3 gate: weave, flicker, scratches, dust, vignette.

Not a 1950s flat cartoon (no limited animation, no colour), not a retro filter over modern animation (no joints, no rendered shading), not a silent still (the beat is the engine).

Signature elements to keep in every film: the rubber-hose hero with pie eyes and gloves, the sunburst title card with fat outlined letters, the breathing set, the worn film gate with an iris to end.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Frame**: 1920×1080 with a 1440×1080 gate centred, black pillarbox either side, gate corners r ≈ 28 px, soft vignette.
- **Hero**: flat fills, one hard-edged form-shadow band in a light grey on the lower right, ink outline about 6–7 px, same width at any zoom. Limb tubes about 17 px wide, one smooth bend, round caps. Gloves: palm, three fat fingers, a thumb and a flared cuff, drawn as a union (stroke all parts thick in ink, then fill all white) so only the outer contour remains. Shoes: black ovals with a small white glint.
- **Object heroes**: the face sits on the body; a secondary feature carries the mood (steam, a droop, a lid). Pores or texture are tiny pale ellipses.
- **Set**: painted once as a mid-grey wash with soft blotches and a patterned wall (vertical stripes), a window with curtains, a wall clock, a counter with panelled cabinet, props with thick ink outlines. The set does not boil.
- **Film damage** (a separate pass over the picture): gate weave ±1.5 px, flicker up to 6 %, 0–3 drifting vertical scratches, a handful of dust specks that change every 1/12 s, vignette.

## 3. Colour logic

- **Greyscale only**: a ramp of about six greys plus a fixed paper white and ink black. The ramp takes a faint tint from `--utama` (about 10–14 %) so the world follows the brand without becoming colourful. Paper white (`--kertas`) and ink black (`--tinta`) are fixed look tokens and own the extremes: the hero is always the whitest and darkest thing on screen.
- Title plate, subtitle plate and the price sign are paper and ink, text in ink or paper, never brand colours.
- The **end card** is the brand's: `--latar` as the field, `--teks` for the headline, `--utama-di-latar` for the price, `--aksen-di-latar` for the contact line.
- Form shadow is one flat grey band, never a gradient.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the end-card headline: **Fredoka 700** (round, retro-friendly), 124 px headline, 104 px figure. Title card letters are Fredoka 700 at 190 px with a 26 px ink stroke painted under the fill and a 7×8 px ink drop shadow, one `span` per letter so they can hop.
- `--font-isi` carries the contact line: **Poppins 800** at 58 px.
- Subtitle and plate captions: **IM Fell English** uppercase, 40 px, tracking 0.06–0.22em, on a near-black plate with a double white rule (6 px and 3 px rings). Pop on and off, no fades. One card at a time, held at least 1.8 s.
- Other families that suit when the brand has none: Limelight for capitals, Archivo Black for a heavier title.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Hero on twos**: every drawing changes 12 times a second; the camera and the iris move smoothly. Quantise time with `floor(t × 12) / 12` for the hero, the set and the film damage.
- **Beat grid**: 120 bpm (0.5 s a beat, an even number of drawings). Breathing is `cos(2π × beats)`: scale y `1 + c`, scale x `1 − 0.8c`, amplitude 0.06–0.07 on joy, 0.02 when sad. Every prop breathes in phase.
- **Hop** on each beat: `abs(sin(π × beat))` × 34 px.
- **Limbs** move by their end points: a wave is ±22 px at 2 cycles a second; a limp arm hangs at 120 px below the shoulder; a point holds almost still.
- **Pop-ins** use `back.out(2.4)` over 0.35 s; the sign swings in with `elastic.out(1, 0.45)` over 0.7 s from −14°.
- **Camera**: one slow push-in (`sine.inOut`, scale 1 → 1.16 over about 4 s) per shot; a cut brings a small settle (scale 1.1 → 1 in 0.5 s, `power3.out`).
- **Freeze**: when the band stops (about 13.2 s) the hero and the set stop completely, breathing included.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked stage-wide card on a sunburst | A proscenium: this is a show | a title; a brand introduction |
| Hard cut on the beat | The next gag arrives | problem to answer; before and after |
| Slow push-in on a medium shot | Feeling builds | a worry; a taste; a realisation |
| Medium shot, hero ≈ 1/3 of frame height | Every step is a note | a demonstration; a dance; an explanation |
| Iris close on the hero, iris open on a card | The film is an object | an ending; a scene change with a gag |

Faces must read: no far-wide shot for a gag. Transitions are hard cuts and irises; no dissolves.

## 7. Native moves

- **Everything breathes on the beat.** The set is a character; at the peak the whole world dances in sync. *Fits content like:* a snack factory's jars; a kids' channel's classroom; a neighbourhood waking up.
- **Rubber-hose stretch and limp.** Limbs reach or hang at any length. *Fits content like:* a mascot reaching a high shelf; a tired hero before a fix; a handshake across town.
- **Fat-letter title card.** A framed plate on a sunburst, letters hopping in a wave. *Fits content like:* a product name; a story title; a class opener.
- **The film is a physical object.** The iris closes on the hero and reopens on the end card; the band stops and everything freezes. *Fits content like:* a brand reveal; "the end?"; a bedtime story.
- **Title-card narration.** One short line on a plate instead of a voice. *Fits content like:* a shop's storage tip; a joke; a safety rhyme.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Flat grey frames: keep the hero pure paper and ink against a mid-grey set.
- Wide shots kill gags: stay at medium.
- Sad brows read angry: slant them down toward the outer end.
- A limb behind the body is hidden by its silhouette: send arms outward.
- Hue creeps in through the brand: keep the tint small and the end card as the only place the brand colour fills a field.
- Text on the plates stays paper and ink; leave room, plates are fixed width.

# 1930s cartoon: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3.6, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: title card on a slow sunburst: a framed plate pops in, fat outlined letters hop in a wave, one slow push-in
- id: kartu judul di atas sinar matahari pelan: pelat berbingkai muncul, huruf tebal berkontur melompat bergelombang

## problem

- en: hard cut into the set: the hero droops, limbs limp, drops fall, slow push-in, a title card states the trouble
- id: potong keras ke set: tokoh lemas, lengan terkulai, tetes jatuh, kamera mendorong pelan, kartu teks menyebut masalahnya

## fact

- en: medium shot, hero points at the prop with a glove; the prop breathes in time; a title card holds the fact
- id: bidikan sedang, tokoh menunjuk benda dengan sarung tangan; benda bernapas mengikuti ketukan; kartu teks memuat faktanya

## step

- en: one beat per step: the hero acts it out on a hop, the object it touches bounces, one title card per step
- id: satu ketukan per langkah: tokoh memeragakannya sambil melompat, benda yang disentuh memantul, satu kartu teks per langkah

## compare

- en: two takes by hard cut on the beat: the droopy hero, then the bouncing one, same framing, same set
- id: dua potongan keras tepat di ketukan: tokoh lemas lalu tokoh melompat, bingkai dan set sama

## number

- en: the figure on a hanging card swung in with an elastic overshoot; the hero hops under it, the whole set breathing
- id: angka di papan gantung yang diayun masuk dengan pantulan elastis; tokoh melompat di bawahnya, seisi set bernapas

## proof

- en: the hero grins and waves both gloves while the set dances on every beat; a title card carries the quote
- id: tokoh nyengir dan melambai dua sarung tangan sementara seisi set menari tiap ketukan; kartu teks memuat kutipan

## offer

- en: joyful hop, sign swings down with the price, props bounce in phase, a title card names the deal
- id: tokoh melompat riang, papan harga diayun turun, benda-benda memantul serempak, kartu teks menyebut tawarannya

## cta

- en: iris closes on the hero, iris reopens on a brand-colour end card; type rises in, everything freezes still for 2 s
- id: iris menutup di tokoh, lalu terbuka ke kartu penutup warna brand; teks naik, semuanya membeku diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the band stops: hero freezes mid-bow, a final title card pops on, held still for 2 s
- id: band berhenti: tokoh membeku saat membungkuk, kartu teks terakhir muncul, ditahan diam 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Kartun 1930-an</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Fredoka"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IM Fell English"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f1eee6; --latar-2: #e2dfd6; --utama: #6b6963; --aksen: #3b3a37;
        --teks: #0e0d0c; --teks-redup: #3b3a37; --teks-di-utama: #fcfbf7; --teks-di-aksen: #fcfbf7;
        --utama-di-latar: #3b3a37; --aksen-di-latar: #0e0d0c;
        --font-judul: "Fredoka", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik tampilan ini: tinta dan kertas tetap, tangga abu-abu yang sedikit ikut warna utama. */
        --tinta: #0e0d0c; --kertas: #fcfbf7; --font-kuno: "IM Fell English", "Noto Sans", serif;
        --abu-1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 10%, #cfccc3);
        --abu-2: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 14%, #a8a59d);
        --abu-3: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 14%, #7d7a74);
        --abu-4: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 12%, #55534f);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tinta); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--tinta); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .lap { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      /* Gerbang film 4:3: 1440 x 1080 di tengah, pilar hitam di kiri-kanan. */
      #gerbang { position: absolute; left: 240px; top: 0; width: 1440px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--tinta); }
      #goyang { position: absolute; inset: -6px; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
      .dunia { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 50% 70%; }
      svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1440px; height: 1080px; overflow: visible; }
      .tinta { fill: var(--tinta); stroke: var(--tinta); }
      .tebal { stroke: var(--tinta); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .kertas { fill: var(--kertas); }
      .selang { fill: none; stroke: var(--tinta); stroke-width: 17; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .jar { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
      /* Adegan 1: kartu judul di atas sinar matahari. */
      #sinar { position: absolute; left: -480px; top: -660px; width: 2400px; height: 2400px;
        background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--abu-1) 0 7.5deg, var(--abu-3) 7.5deg 15deg); }
      #plat { position: absolute; left: 150px; top: 230px; width: 1140px; height: 620px; border-radius: 44px; background: var(--kertas);
        border: 10px solid var(--tinta); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 10px var(--kertas), inset 0 0 0 14px var(--tinta); text-align: center; }
      .fat { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; font-family: "Fredoka", sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: var(--kertas);
        -webkit-text-stroke: 26px var(--tinta); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 7px 8px 0 var(--tinta); line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
      .fat span { display: inline-block; }
      #t1 { top: 70px; font-size: 190px; }
      #t2 { top: 255px; font-size: 190px; }
      #pita { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 50px; font-family: var(--font-kuno); font-size: 38px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--tinta); }
      /* Kartu subjudul gaya film bisu: pelat hitam, garis ganda putih, tanpa fade. */
      .sub { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; margin: 0 auto; width: max-content; bottom: 40px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 18px 54px; border-radius: 12px;
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 92%, transparent); color: var(--kertas); font-family: var(--font-kuno); font-size: 40px;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px var(--tinta), inset 0 0 0 8px var(--kertas), inset 0 0 0 11px var(--tinta), inset 0 0 0 12px var(--kertas); }
      .papan { position: absolute; left: 950px; top: 150px; width: 380px; padding: 20px 10px 24px; text-align: center; background: var(--kertas); border: 8px solid var(--tinta);
        border-radius: 22px; color: var(--tinta); transform-origin: 50% 0; }
      .papan b { display: block; font-family: "Fredoka", sans-serif; font-size: 84px; line-height: 1.05; }
      .papan i { font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-kuno); font-size: 36px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
      /* Adegan 4: kartu penutup berwarna brand, dibuka dengan iris. */
      #s4 { background: var(--latar); }
      #kartu { position: absolute; left: 640px; right: 60px; top: 260px; }
      #kartu .j { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 112px; line-height: 1.02; color: var(--teks); }
      #kartu .h { margin-top: 28px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 104px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      #kartu .w { margin-top: 18px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-weight: 800; font-size: 58px; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      #kartu .r { margin-top: 26px; width: 300px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--utama); }
      /* Kerusakan film: vinyet, kedip, goresan, debu. Digambar sekali, hanya digeser. */
      #vinyet { background: radial-gradient(75% 75% at 50% 50%, transparent 45%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta) 70%, transparent)); pointer-events: none; }
      #kedip { background: var(--kertas); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      .gores { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 2px; height: 1080px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kertas) 50%, transparent); }
      .debu { position: absolute; width: 5px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tinta); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div id="gerbang"><div id="goyang">
        <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
          <div id="sinar"></div>
          <div id="plat">
            <div class="fat" id="t1">Kerupuk</div>
            <div class="fat" id="t2">Si Renyah</div>
            <div id="pita">Pabrik rumahan Bu Tini</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="problem"><div class="dunia"></div><div class="sub">Semalam toplesnya lupa ditutup... lemas!</div></div>
        <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="offer"><div class="dunia"></div>
          <div class="papan"><b>Rp12.000</b><i>satu toples rapat</i></div>
          <div class="sub">Tutup rapat, renyah tiga puluh hari!</div>
        </div>
        <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="cta"><div class="dunia"></div>
          <div id="kartu"><div class="j">Pesan toples pertamamu</div><div class="r"></div><div class="h">Rp12.000</div><div class="w">Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="lap" id="kedip"></div>
        <div class="lap" id="vinyet"></div>
        <div class="lap" id="debu"></div>
      </div></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      // PRNG berbenih supaya hasilnya sama di setiap render.
      function rng(seed) { let a = seed; return () => { a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
      const pts = (a) => a.map((p) => p[0].toFixed(1) + "," + p[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ");
      function svg(host, html) { const s = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg"); s.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 1440 1080"); s.innerHTML = html; host.appendChild(s); return s; }

      // Latar warung: dinding bermotif, jendela bertirai, jam, rak. Dilukis sekali.
      function latar(host, tutup) {
        const r = rng(7);
        let h = '<rect width="1440" height="1080" style="fill:var(--abu-2)"/>';
        for (let x = 0; x < 1440; x += 72) h += `<rect x="${x}" width="36" height="800" style="fill:var(--abu-3);opacity:.35"/>`;
        for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) h += `<ellipse cx="${r() * 1440}" cy="${r() * 800}" rx="${50 + r() * 90}" ry="${30 + r() * 50}" style="fill:var(--abu-3);opacity:.12"/>`;
        // Dinding ubin di bawah, rak dengan toples (satu terbuka) dan dua panci.
        h += '<rect x="0" y="560" width="1440" height="240" style="fill:var(--abu-1);opacity:.55"/><path d="';
        for (let x = 0; x <= 1440; x += 80) h += `M${x} 560V800`;
        for (let y = 560; y <= 800; y += 80) h += `M0 ${y}H1440`;
        h += '" class="tebal" style="fill:none;stroke-width:3;opacity:.5"/>';
        h += '<defs><g id="tp"><rect x="-28" y="-80" width="56" height="80" rx="10" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/><ellipse cy="-20" rx="20" ry="8" class="tebal kertas"/><ellipse cy="-42" rx="20" ry="8" class="tebal kertas"/><rect x="-32" y="-98" width="64" height="20" rx="7" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/></g>';
        h += '<g id="pn"><path d="M-46 0V-50Q0 -64 46 -50V0Z" class="tebal kertas"/><rect x="-52" y="-66" width="104" height="16" rx="8" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/><circle cy="-76" r="8" class="tinta"/></g></defs>';
        h += '<rect x="400" y="440" width="560" height="22" rx="6" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/>';
        [450, 530, 610].forEach((x) => (h += `<use href="#tp" x="${x}" y="440"/>`));
        h += '<g transform="translate(690 440)"><g id="tpb"><rect x="-28" y="-80" width="56" height="80" rx="10" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/><ellipse cy="-20" rx="20" ry="8" class="tebal kertas"/></g></g><rect x="710" y="-4" width="64" height="20" rx="7" transform="translate(0 438) rotate(-14 740 6)" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/>';
        h += '<use href="#pn" x="800" y="440"/><use href="#pn" x="890" y="440"/>';
        h += '<rect x="80" y="110" width="270" height="300" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/><path d="M215 110V410M80 260H350" class="tebal" style="fill:none"/>';
        h += '<path d="M60 90Q110 250 70 440H150Q130 250 170 90ZM370 90Q320 250 360 440H280Q300 250 260 90Z" class="tebal kertas"/>';
        h += '<circle cx="1180" cy="250" r="78" class="tebal kertas"/><path d="M1180 190V250L1220 270" class="tebal" style="fill:none"/><circle cx="1180" cy="250" r="9" class="tinta"/>';
        h += '<rect x="0" y="800" width="1440" height="280" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/><rect x="0" y="800" width="1440" height="26" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/>';
        for (let x = 20; x < 1440; x += 330) h += `<rect x="${x}" y="860" width="290" height="200" rx="10" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-3)"/><path d="M${x + 145} 860V1060" class="tebal" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4"/><circle cx="${x + 125}" cy="960" r="9" class="tinta"/><circle cx="${x + 165}" cy="960" r="9" class="tinta"/>`;
        svg(host, h);
        // Tiga toples; yang tengah terbuka di adegan masalah. Bernapas mengikuti ketukan.
        let j = "";
        [950, 1090, 1230].forEach((x, i) => {
          const buka = tutup === 0 && i === 1;
          j += `<g transform="translate(${x} 800)"><g class="jar"><rect x="-55" y="-190" width="110" height="190" rx="20" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-1)"/>`;
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) j += `<ellipse cx="0" cy="${-30 - k * 38}" rx="42" ry="17" class="tebal kertas"/>`;
          j += buka ? '<rect x="40" y="-30" width="96" height="28" rx="8" transform="rotate(-8 90 -16)" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/>'
            : '<rect x="-62" y="-222" width="124" height="36" rx="12" class="tebal" style="fill:var(--abu-4)"/>';
          j += "</g></g>";
        });
        return svg(host, j).querySelectorAll(".jar");
      }

      // Tokoh: kerupuk bulat seluruh badannya, selang karet hitam, sarung tangan putih, mata kue pai, sepatu bulat.
      let uid = 0;
      function tokoh(host) {
        const n = ++uid, r = rng(11);
        const body = [], bayang = [];
        for (let a = 0; a < 360; a += 6) { const t = (a * Math.PI) / 180, rr = 122 + 6 * Math.sin(t * 9); body.push([Math.cos(t) * rr, Math.sin(t) * rr * 1.04]); }
        for (let a = 10; a <= 110; a += 6) { const t = (a * Math.PI) / 180; bayang.push([Math.cos(t) * 122, Math.sin(t) * 127]); }
        for (let a = 110; a >= 10; a -= 6) { const t = (a * Math.PI) / 180; bayang.push([Math.cos(t) * 92 - 22, Math.sin(t) * 96 - 14]); }
        let pori = "";
